title: Immutable clean bundles and signed proof hashes
summary: Deployable builds refuse dirty source, retain a versioned clean-commit manifest and reuse an existing verified artifact without replacing it. Test and staging proofs sign the actual bundle hash; production carries that exact hash. The newest verdict must pass and name the same bytes. The logbook adds a nullable hash column in place, preserving all legacy rows and mixed-version reads/writes. Hashless legacy verdicts remain visible but cannot open a promotion gate.
proves: architect promote --to production refuses a revision without staging verdicts and accepts one that has them. A dirty build followed by restoring source cannot replace the clean artifact. A newest signed staging verdict with another hash or no hash refuses production; matching hash-bound verdicts move exactly the staged bytes, and production carries that hash. Legacy cache provenance is refused, then a real clean bundle rebuild succeeds after preserving that cache aside. A real workerd logbook upgrades its own legacy persisted SQLite schema without losing rows or releases, keeps old hashless rows readable, rejects malformed hashes, round-trips new signed hashes, and restarts through idempotent initialization.

captions.01-build-fails-first: Before implementation: immutable-file, dirty-build and legacy-provenance regressions fail.
captions.02-logbook-fails-first: Before implementation: the real logbook accepts a malformed hash and drops a valid one.
captions.03-promote-fails-first: Before implementation: production accepts a latest staging verdict for different bytes.
captions.04-build-and-promotion: Build, promotion and verdict client checks pass through real bundles, workerd, collectors and OIDC.
captions.05-logbook-migration: Real persisted logbook migration, compatibility, signed hash roundtrip and restart, plus existing SQL checks.
captions.06-workspace-checks: Nx reset, sync, all-project lint/typecheck, sync check and diff whitespace check.
captions.07-final-promotion: Explicit assertions bind staging and carried production verdicts to the same bundle hash.
captions.08-legacy-cache-recovery: A legacy cache stays untrusted; preserving it aside permits a new real clean build without rewriting history.
captions.09-final-build-checks: Final build regressions after actionable recovery and typed subprocess failure handling.
captions.10-final-workspace-checks: Final Nx reset/sync, all-project lint/typecheck, generated drift check and diff check.
captions.11-integrated-build-promote-verdicts: The conductor reruns Build, promotion and verdict checks after combining both correctness fixes.
captions.12-integrated-logbook-migration: The conductor reruns real logbook and persisted legacy-schema migration checks after integration.
captions.13-integrated-test-worlds: The conductor verifies actual test-world proofs with signed hashes and the atomic lease correction together.
